title: Telescope homotopy colimits are termwise filtered colimits
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site, $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$, and let $E_0^\bullet\to E_1^\bullet\to\cdots$ be a sequence of cochain complexes of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. Define its homotopy colimit as the cone of $1-\operatorname{shift}:\bigoplus_n E_n^\bullet\to\bigoplus_n E_n^\bullet$. The canonical map from this homotopy colimit to the termwise filtered colimit $\varinjlim_n E_n^\bullet$ is a quasi-isomorphism [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules].
